detailed_descriptions_html.en:
MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries - Chaos Reign

Three years have passed since the victory against the Clans, and the truce of Tukayyid came into effect. Even still, chaos threatens to erupt at any moment across the universe. ComStar's betrayal and the assassination of Archon Melissa Steiner threaten the fragile unity of the Inner Sphere. As tensions rise and new foes emerge, mercenary Commander Jake Mason uncovers a cache of critical Clan intelligence that could change the course of the war. Multiple new questlines, factions, conflict zones, ‘Mechs, weapon types, ground vehicles, and battle armor join the battlefield.

Campaign & Missions

  • 2 new Priority Transmission campaigns featuring the Federated Commonwealth and Free Worlds League, starting from 3055

  • 3 new High Reward questlines featuring new ‘Mechs and new Factions

  • Experience the new mission type: Guerrilla Warfare

  • New Factions and Conflict Zones emerge as the Starmap expands into 3058

New Mechs and More

  • All New Inner Sphere Omnimech Sunder

  • New BattleMech Chassis - Incubus, Jenner IIC, Shadow Hawk IIC, BushWacker, and Kodiak

  • New OmniMech Chassis - Linebacker, Ebon Jaguar, Night Gyr, and Naga

  • New Clanbuster Com Guard Variants, Artillery-Capable Variants, and Clan-Tech Variants

  • New Weapon types - including Arrow IV Artillery, Light Autocannons, and X-Pulse lasers.

  • New Ground Vehicles and Battle Armor
